Before: a chicken wrap cut in half (~250 g, ~450 kcal), a fruit bowl (~150 g, ~80 kcal), a side salad (~80 g, ~60 kcal with dressing), a dressing cup (~30 g, ~60 kcal), and a dark drink (cola, ~240 g, ~100 kcal).

After: the wrap is mostly eaten, with some lettuce and tortilla scraps left (~40 g left). The fruit has some left (maybe 40% of the grapes and melon are gone, with strawberries and blueberries remaining), so about 60% was eaten. The salad was roughly half eaten, since the greens are gone but tomato and cucumber remain. The dressing cup is mostly consumed or used. The drink has about 20% left.

Eaten:
- Wrap: ~210 g, ~380 kcal
- Fruit: ~90 g, ~50 kcal
- Salad: ~40 g, ~35 kcal
- Dressing: ~20 g, ~40 kcal
- Drink: ~190 g, ~80 kcal

Total is about 585 kcal and 550 g. If the drink is counted as food mass, the figure is about 550 g. I'll go with that.
